intro.narration: [excited] Heey — how do you solve ninety-two times eleven in your head? [pause] Watch this.

steps.narration: [curious] Ninety-two times eleven. [pause] Looks tricky, but there's a shortcut.
[confident] Split the digits — nine and two. [pause] Add them: nine plus two is eleven.
[thoughtful] Eleven has two digits — you can't just drop it between. [pause] So carry the one over.
[excited] Nine plus one is ten. [warm] The answer? One thousand and twelve.
